context: Bivariate treemap encoding revenue as area, sector as color, subcategory as pattern shape, and growth rate as pattern spacing (density)
first_impression: Structurally honest treemap with data-driven domains and correct area-proportional encoding, but the pattern-shape channel is ambiguous across categories.
what_works: Area encoding via d3.hierarchy().sum() is mathematically correct; growth spacing scale uses d3.extent() for a data-driven domain rather than magic numbers.
what_doesnt: Pattern shape maps subcategories by index (si % 6), so the same pattern represents different subcategories across categories — the legend omits this per-category context, creating a decoding ambiguity; no key function on .data(leaves).join('g') means reshuffled data could corrupt DOM-order-sensitive rendering.
